events.info: Two extraordinary voices in contemporary jazz and soul come together for an unforgettable evening of music. Grammy Award-winning vocalist Gregory Porter has captivated audiences worldwide with his unmistakable baritone, heartfelt songwriting, and signature blend of jazz, gospel, blues, and soul. Joining him is acclaimed singer, songwriter, and keyboardist Jarrod Lawson, whose remarkable vocals and sophisticated fusion of soul, jazz, and R&B have earned international praise. Together, Porter and Lawson bring exceptional musicianship, powerful storytelling, and undeniable soul to the stage for a night celebrating the timeless sound and spirit of modern jazz.
